title: ForestOS Phase 120 — Critical Domain Tenant Coverage Queue
method: Static source-pattern triage of selected domain controllers and services. Signals can be false positives or false negatives; absence of a signal is not proof of enforcement.

requiredEvidence: Trace the actual controller-to-service path; static pattern matching is not a call graph.
Verify organization scope in every read/write predicate or in a proven shared enforcement layer.
Test same-tenant allow and cross-tenant deny for list, detail, create, update, delete and dashboard/aggregate routes where applicable.
Record reviewer, runtime test evidence, and disposition before closing.
